entities.name: DLG1
observations: Cardiac-specific deletion of DLG1/SAP97 in αMHC-Cre;Dlg1 floxed mice reduced IK1, Ito, and IKur potassium currents.
Maximal action-potential upstroke velocity was unchanged, supporting no detectable change in cardiac sodium current INa.

entities.name: PMID:25447080
observations: Singh et al., Heart Rhythm (2015), studied cardiomyocyte-specific SAP97/DLG1 ablation in mice.
The knockout prolonged action-potential duration and reduced IK1, Ito, and IKur; sodium current was not detectably altered based on unchanged maximal upstroke velocity.

entities.name: SAP97 K current reduction
observations: In mouse cardiomyocytes with cardiac-specific SAP97/DLG1 deletion, IK1, Ito, and IKur were decreased, with prolonged action-potential duration.
The abstract did not identify IKr or IKs as affected currents.

entities.name: SAP97 sodium current unchanged
observations: Cardiac-specific SAP97/DLG1 deletion did not produce a detectable sodium-current effect; maximal action-potential upstroke velocity was unchanged.
